استقبلوا (form X)
# اِسْتَقْبَلُوا (istaqbalū) /is.taq.ba.luː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَقْبَلَ (istaqbala)
# اُسْتُقْبِلُوا (ustuqbilū) /us.tuq.bi.luː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَقْبَلَ (istaqbala)
# اِسْتَقْبِلُوا (istaqbilū) /is.taq.bi.luː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَقْبَلَ (istaqbala)
